name: An impossible ?today= date is refused with a message and the real date is used

planSteps.description: Navigate to /?today=2026-02-30&fresh=1 (30 February does not exist)
An alert (data-testid=today-error) says the today parameter is not a real calendar date
The date shown (data-testid=today-date) is a real YYYY-MM-DD date, not 2026-02-30
